The overall profile is simultaneously bright and dank, striking an interesting balance between candy-like sweetness and pungent earthiness.
8003f2b26a89.misc: Produced by Northpark as a proprietary blended pre-roll, this indica-leaning hybrid sits at a relatively approachable 14.2% THC, making it well-suited for intermediate consumers or those sensitive to high-potency products. The combination of Myrcene and Limonene drives the relaxing yet uplifting effect profile, while Caryophyllene adds a subtle spicy bite and potential anti-inflammatory benefit. Best consumed in the early evening when you want to unwind without full sedation; the cerebral lift from the Amnesia and Lemon Tree genetics prevents it from being a pure couch-lock experience.

46c01c7585d2.lineage: Edible product — no genetic strain lineage applicable. Blue Raspberry is a flavored gummy format by Voyageur, dosed at 10mg THC per gummy with 10 gummies per pack (100mg total THC).
46c01c7585d2.therapeutic: Stress relief, mild to moderate pain management, anxiety reduction, sleep support, appetite stimulation, mood elevation
46c01c7585d2.negative: Overconsumption risk due to delayed onset (30–120 minutes); potential anxiety or paranoia at high doses, dry mouth, increased heart rate, impaired coordination and cognition, not recommended for cannabis-naive users to exceed one gummy without waiting
46c01c7585d2.aroma: As a gummy edible, the sensory experience is flavor-forward rather than aromatic — expect a sweet, candy-like blue raspberry scent reminiscent of artificial berry confections with a tart, fruity finish. There is no cannabis aroma present in the final product.
46c01c7585d2.misc: Each gummy contains a precise 10mg THC dose, making this product well-suited for both beginner and experienced consumers who prefer portion control. New users should start with half a gummy (5mg) and wait at least 90 minutes before redosing to avoid overconsumption. Voyageur's gummy format offers a discreet, smoke-free consumption method ideal for on-the-go use or social settings where discretion is preferred.

6bba413e0823.lineage: Fro'Do x Alaskan Yeti, then crossed with Lil Miss Sunshine (LilMissHS) — Fro'Do is a cross of Frosty D (an indica-leaning hybrid) with strong resin production genetics; Alaskan Yeti is a sativa-dominant strain known for energetic and cerebral effects; Lil Miss Sunshine contributes uplifting, citrus-forward sativa influence. Bred and produced by Northpark Cannabis.
6bba413e0823.therapeutic: Stress relief, mood elevation, mild depression, fatigue, lack of focus, mild anxiety, appetite stimulation
6bba413e0823.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, mild paranoia at higher doses, possible dizziness for low-tolerance users, may cause restlessness in sensitive sativa consumers
6bba413e0823.aroma: A bright and resinous opening of sweet tropical fruit and zesty lemon citrus gives way to a grounding undercurrent of earthy pine and a subtle peppery spice that lingers on the exhale. The overall bouquet is fresh, lively, and inviting with a slight herbal complexity tied together by the myrcene backbone.
6bba413e0823.misc: Produced by Northpark, this sativa-leaning hybrid sits at a moderate 17.1% THC, making it approachable for intermediate consumers while still delivering noticeable euphoric and focusing effects. The buds typically display a frosty, trichome-rich appearance consistent with the Yeti lineage, with medium-green coloring and amber pistils. Best consumed during daytime or early afternoon when focus and uplifting energy are desired — well-suited for creative tasks, social settings, or outdoor activities.

a62c1cb48f44.therapeutic: Stress relief, mild anxiety, depression, fatigue, creative blocks, mild pain
a62c1cb48f44.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, mild paranoia at higher doses, potential drowsiness as effects progress
a62c1cb48f44.aroma: A complex bouquet opens with pungent diesel fuel undertones layered over ripe stone fruit and berries, giving way to a surprisingly delicate floral rose note on the exhale. The sweetness lingers in a candy-like finish reminiscent of its Cotton Candy parentage.
a62c1cb48f44.misc: PR Fog Dog is a Northpark house blend crossing the sugary, euphoric Cotton Candy strain with the earthy, OG-forward Gravenstein OG, yielding a balanced indica-leaning hybrid that sits at a modest 17.2% THC — accessible for intermediate consumers without overwhelming novices. Buds typically present with a dense, frosty structure, forest green calos dusted in trichomes with amber pistils reflecting the indica heritage. Best enjoyed in the early evening when creative pursuits are still on the agenda but relaxation is the ultimate destination, making it ideal for artists, musicians, or winding down after a demanding day.

8a1828b347ce.lineage: True OG x Strawberry Banana x Blackberry — True OG is an OG Kush phenotype (Elemental Seeds), Strawberry Banana is a cross of Crockett's Banana Kush x Strawberry Bubblegum (DNA Genetics / Crockett Family Farms), and Blackberry likely refers to Blackberry Kush or Blackberry by Nirvana Seeds, contributing deep berry and floral notes to the hybrid blend
8a1828b347ce.therapeutic: Stress relief, mild anxiety reduction, mood elevation, creative block, mild pain and tension, fatigue, depression
8a1828b347ce.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, possible mild paranoia or anxiety in sensitive users at higher doses, may cause drowsiness in some users despite hybrid classification — pace consumption especially if tolerance is low
8a1828b347ce.aroma: A vibrant burst of ripe mixed berries and sun-warmed citrus greets the nose first, followed by a subtle earthy, piney undertone from the myrcene and pinene interplay that grounds the sweetness and keeps it from feeling cloying.
8a1828b347ce.misc: Produced by Northpark as a pre-roll, this hybrid sits at a moderate 14.1% THC, making it approachable for newer consumers while still satisfying for casual users. The terpene profile — led by myrcene for body ease, pinene for mental clarity, limonene for mood lift, and caryophyllene for light stress relief — supports its balanced, functional hybrid effects. Best suited for afternoon or early evening use when creativity and relaxation are both desired without full sedation.

sw242336.lineage: GMO (Garlic Cookies) x Han-Solo Burger (Skunk House Genetics)
sw242336.therapeutic: Inflammation, chronic pain, insomnia, stress, appetite stimulation
sw242336.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, heavy sedation — not for daytime use. Can be overwhelming for novices.
sw242336.aroma: Pungent gas and diesel, spicy savory garlic notes, sour lemon, hints of cheese and fuel — unmistakably GMO-forward
sw242336.misc: Bred by Skunk House Genetics. Also known as GMO BX. One of the hardest-hitting indicas on the market — THC 25–30%+. Fast-acting, long-lasting body stone. Best reserved for evening or end-of-day use. Not for new consumers.

sw242346.lineage: MAC (Miracle Alien Cookies) x Grape Stomper (Gage Green Seeds)
sw242346.therapeutic: Chronic pain, stress, insomnia, mood disorders, nausea
sw242346.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, couch-lock at high doses
sw242346.aroma: Creamy grape candy, sweet apple, citrus zest, light floral, earthy funk on the finish
sw242346.misc: Cross of two award-winning genetics. MAC contributes creamy citrus and potency; Grape Stomper adds grape and fruit sweetness. THC 24–29%. Available in half-ounce — great value buy. Dense, trichome-heavy flowers with deep purple and green hues. Best for evening use.

sw242332.lineage: Animal Mints x Kush Mints (Seed Junky Genetics)
sw242332.therapeutic: Depression, fatigue, stress, anxiety, mild chronic pain
sw242332.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, possible anxiety at high doses in novice users
sw242332.aroma: Clean floral soap, fresh mint, citrus zest, light cheese notes, pine — one of the most distinctive and refreshing terpene profiles in cannabis
sw242332.misc: Created by Seed Junky Genetics. Famously described as smelling like fresh soap or floral laundry detergent — a truly unique, clean aroma. THC 20–26%. Euphoric and uplifting with a clean, lasting head high. Strong daytime strain for focus and creativity.

sw242349.lineage: The Soap x Velvet Runtz (Campfire Cannabis in-house cross)
sw242349.therapeutic: Stress, fatigue, depression, mild chronic pain, creative blocks
sw242349.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, occasional anxiety at high doses
sw242349.aroma: Clean soapy citrus, sweet mixed berry, light diesel backbone, faint pine and earthy woods
sw242349.misc: House cross by Campfire Cannabis combining The Soap's clean citrus with Velvet Runtz candy sweetness. THC 20–25%. Versatile hybrid — sativa-leaning first hour then settles into relaxed body state. Great for daytime creative work or afternoon social sessions.

sw230647.lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicana Cookies (Franchise Genetics)
sw230647.therapeutic: Stress, depression, fatigue, mild pain, creative blocks
sw230647.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, occasional mild anxiety
sw230647.aroma: Fresh orange and grapefruit citrus burst, sweet black cherry, earthy tropical undertones, faint cookie dough base
sw230647.misc: Bred by Franchise Genetics. One of the most vibrant citrus terpene profiles available. Combines Black Cherry Punch's sweet fruitiness with Tropicana Cookies' heavy citrus terps. THC 18–24%. Excellent daytime or social strain — uplifting, creative, mood-enhancing.

sw242352.lineage: Chem's Sister x Sour Dubb x Chocolate Diesel (GG Strains)
sw242352.therapeutic: Chronic pain, insomnia, PTSD, depression, muscle spasms
sw242352.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, heavy sedation — can be overwhelming for novice users
sw242352.aroma: Pungent diesel and mocha chocolate, earthy pine resin, coffee grounds, chemical fuel — one of the most recognizable aromas in cannabis
sw242352.misc: One of the most iconic strains ever created. Multiple Cannabis Cup winner. Bred by GG Strains. THC 25–32%. Extremely sticky, resin-coated buds. Powerful and fast-acting — couch-lock is common at higher doses. Best reserved for experienced users in the evening.

sw318589.lineage: Grape Ape x Zkittlez (also known as Grape Zkittlez)
sw318589.therapeutic: Stress, anxiety, mild pain, mood enhancement, appetite
sw318589.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, potential drowsiness at higher doses
sw318589.aroma: Intense grape candy, mixed berry compote, sweet citrus, tropical Zkittlez notes, light earthy base
sw318589.misc: Natural cross combining Grape Ape's deep grape flavor with Zkittlez' candy sweetness. THC 19–24%. Dense colorful buds with purple hues. Well-balanced hybrid — calming without being fully sedating. Popular for its distinctive grape-forward flavor profile. Good afternoon/social strain.

sw347757.lineage: Purple Thai x Undisclosed Hybrid (Campfire Cannabis); Purple Thai itself is a classic sativa-dominant landrace cross of Thai stick genetics and Purple varieties, likely carrying Afghani influence through the purple-expressing parent
sw347757.therapeutic: Stress relief, depression, fatigue, mild anxiety, appetite stimulation, focus disorders, mood elevation
sw347757.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, mild paranoia in sensitive users or at higher doses, potential anxiousness due to sativa-forward profile, overconsumption may cause racing thoughts
sw347757.aroma: Bangkok Purple opens with a vibrant burst of sun-ripened blueberry and tropical citrus, layered over a delicate floral undercurrent of lavender and jasmine. As the bouquet settles, warm hints of spice and earthy resin emerge, giving it an exotic, Southeast Asian-inspired complexity.
sw347757.misc: Produced by Campfire Cannabis, Bangkok Purple is a sativa-leaning hybrid with a moderate THC content of 16.9%, making it approachable for intermediate consumers while still delivering a meaningful effect. Buds are expected to display deep purple and forest green hues with amber trichomes, consistent with its Purple Thai heritage and the linalool-rich terpene profile that reinforces the lavender and floral notes. Best enjoyed during morning or early afternoon sessions when its energetic, focusing, and motivating qualities can be fully leveraged — particularly well-suited for creative work, social activity, or outdoor adventures.

sw371811.lineage: Durban Poison S1 (self-pollinated Durban Poison) × AVL (Appalachian Valley Line, a regional sativa-dominant cultivar); produced by Campfire Cannabis
sw371811.therapeutic: Depression, fatigue, ADD/ADHD, stress, mild anxiety, creative blocks, low motivation
sw371811.negative: Dry mouth, dry eyes, mild paranoia or racing thoughts at higher doses, potential overstimulation in anxiety-prone users, not recommended for evening use
sw371811.aroma: Terp Poison opens with a bright, zesty citrus burst layered over a sharp diesel fuel backbone, with a subtle floral sweetness from the ocimene that rounds out the nose. As the bud breaks apart, earthy anise-like undertones inherited from the Durban Poison lineage emerge alongside a faintly spicy, herbal complexity.
sw371811.misc: This sativa-leaning hybrid leans heavily on its Durban Poison S1 heritage, delivering a clean, cerebral, and uplifting experience consistent with South African landrace genetics. sw242343.lineage: Biscotti x Sour Dubb x Chocolate Diesel (Seed Junky Genetics, popularized by Doja Exclusive / Wizards of the Coast collaboration)
sw242343.therapeutic: Stress relief, anxiety reduction, depression, appetite stimulation, mild pain management, creative blocks, fatigue

sw390294.lineage: True OG x Strawberry Banana x Blackberry (Northpark selection; True OG derived from Kush lineage, Strawberry Banana from Serious Seeds via Banana OG x Strawberry OG, Blackberry from DJ Short / Nirvana heritage)
